name: Maruti Suzuki Ertiga
description:
The Maruti Suzuki Ertiga is the quintessential multi-utility vehicle, masterfully balancing physical footprint with maximum passenger capacity. Utilizing Smart Hybrid (SHVS) technology, it provides brake energy regeneration and torque assist, ensuring optimal fuel efficiency. The 50:50 split third-row and 60:40 split second-row seats offer incredible modularity for luggage and passengers.

Specifications:
* Fuel: Diesel / Petrol
* Engine: 1.5L Smart Hybrid
* Transmission: Manual
* Seats: 7 Passengers
* Boot: 209-550 Liters
